full_judgment: 5. He further submits that the FIR story has been proved to be false and fabricated further due to withholding of witnesses Faruque, Gani and Majubur Rahman Howlader and also the Magistrate who examined them under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The legal presumption under Section 114(g) of the Evidence Act is that had they been examined they would not support the FIR version and that of the informant P.W. 1. The High Court Division having failed to consider this aspect of law, the conviction and sentence awarded against the accused petitioners are liable to be set-aside.
